purpose: Cross-discipline engineering drawing semantics for multimodal planning, OCR reconciliation, translation coverage and placement.

source_references.reference: United States National CAD Standard - Uniform Drawing System

supervisor_rules: Build a page object graph before translation: visible text, symbols, arrows, leaders, equipment, table cells and title-panel zones.
Compare multimodal observations with OCR/PDF text. The union is the candidate inventory; OCR absence is never an exemption.
Resolve each candidate as natural language, functional abbreviation, proper name, identifier/value, or graphical symbol.
Translate natural language and functional abbreviations. Preserve identifiers and numeric values while translating their descriptors.
Treat arrowhead, leader, slope mark, electrical connection and section/detail bubble as part of the same semantic block as its label.
For a single-line diagram, plan translations without crossing or hiding conductive paths, protection symbols or source-load hierarchy.
For schedules, segment by ruled cell, item number, equipment/drawing number and typography. Never merge adjacent rows merely because prose continues.
For architectural details, translate image-embedded captions and product notes even when OCR misses them.
For every page, produce a coverage ledger with source anchor, semantic class, translation decision, placement decision and literal-only reason when exempted.
typography_rules: Preserve semantic hierarchy: title, section heading, item heading, body note, dimension and identifier must remain visually distinguishable.
Match boldness, relative size, alignment and rotation of the source role; Chinese may use a compatible CJK font.
A bold source heading requires a bold Chinese companion or bilingual reflow heading.
Do not enlarge body translations until they compete with source titles or drawing numbers.
When space is limited, wrap first, compress line spacing second, permit slight auxiliary-line overlap third, and reduce font size only last.
Do not assign one Chinese font size to a full page. Plan font size per semantic block from source hierarchy, available area and delivery-scale readability.

Candidate visual ratios are: equipment or circuit name 75%-90% of source glyph height, key rated values 65%-80%, multiline parameter explanation 50%-70%, code or terminal gloss 45%-60%. These are planning ranges, not permission to create unreadable microtext.
A representative full explanation must remain more prominent than abbreviated labels on repeated identical devices.
placement_rules: Multimodal visual planning outranks OCR ink occupancy when the rendered page visibly contains usable whitespace.
Keep translations in the immediate local group. Prefer a short leader; do not use a long leader merely to avoid minor CAD-line overlap.
Allow left, right, above, below or angled placement. Preserve the source text and do not fully cover it inside the drawing body.
For non-drawing panels and schedules, remove only the intended text layer/region and re-typeset source plus Chinese in black while preserving borders, logos and identifiers.
All visible non-Chinese natural-language instances are mandatory, including microtext at or below the visual size of FLOW labels.
A translation may lightly cross auxiliary lines, pale equipment boxes or minor CAD geometry, but may not hide conductive paths, junctions, switch states, terminal identifiers or key numeric values.

current_transformer.grouping_rule: Treat consecutive CT lines as one parameter block and preserve every numeric value, unit and inequality.

electrical_code_policy.uncertain_project_code_rule: Preserve the exact code, label it as a project function code or manual review item, and never invent an expansion.
electrical_code_policy.parameter_code_rule: CL.PX, 5P20, 0.2, VA, Vk, Rct and Im are semantic parameter fields and require Chinese explanation; they are not exempt model numbers.

repetition_strategy.name: full-plus-compact
repetition_strategy.full_requirement: At least one representative instance or same-page legend contains the complete field explanation.
repetition_strategy.compact_requirement: An identical repeated instance may use a compact label only when every parameter value, class and purpose matches the full instance.
repetition_strategy.difference_rule: Any changed value, class, purpose or winding requires its own explicit Chinese difference label.

questions: For CT/PT, what are the ratio, class, burden and key excitation limits?
What is its protection, measurement or switching purpose?
Which bay, feeder or equipment group does it belong to?
reverse_reading_test.failure_rule: If Chinese plus preserved numbers and codes cannot answer the applicable questions without reading the English prose, treat the page as under-translated.
